modules.summary: Ch. 1–4: text data and tokenization, attention mechanisms, and a GPT model that generates text. Project: work out the 3090's decoding ceiling against llama.cpp, then build the GPT forward pass.
modules.title: GPT from the ground up

modules.summary: Ch. 5: the training loop, decoding strategies, and loading OpenAI's GPT-2 weights. Project: add a KV cache and batched generation, read the PagedAttention paper, then profile the engine with torch.profiler and Nsight.
modules.title: Pretraining

modules.summary: Ch. 6: fine-tune the GPT into a spam classifier. Project: RMSNorm and softmax kernels in Triton, then a 4-bit dequantize matrix-vector kernel. Week 9 is light.
modules.title: Classification fine-tuning

modules.summary: Ch. 7 and Appendix E: instruction fine-tuning and LoRA. Project: add a paged KV cache, compare it with nano-vllm, and ship the engine with a benchmark write-up.
modules.title: Instruction fine-tuning

modules.summary: Ch. 1–3: the LLM Twin architecture, the tooling, and data engineering. Project: build a gold-labeled extraction set of 100–200 Tagger documents and define your metrics.
modules.title: Architecture and data

modules.summary: Ch. 4–5: the RAG feature pipeline and supervised fine-tuning. Project: run BF16, Q8, Q6, Q4 and Q3 on the 3090, recording quality and tokens per second, and release the tool.
modules.title: RAG and fine-tuning

modules.summary: Ch. 6–7: preference alignment and evaluating LLMs. Project: add few-shot prompting, self-consistency and verify-and-retry, then a QLoRA adapter on the quantized base.
modules.title: Alignment and evaluation

modules.summary: Ch. 8–9: inference optimization and the RAG inference pipeline. Week 9 is light. Project: one rented-GPU session testing MXFP4, the 4-bit format the 3090 cannot run.
modules.title: Inference

modules.summary: Ch. 10–11: deploying the inference pipeline, and MLOps and LLMOps. Project: write the technical report, then post it to r/LocalLLaMA and Hacker News.
modules.title: Deployment and report

modules.summary: Ch. 1–3: what language models are, tokens and embeddings, and the transformer from the inside. Project: text-layer extraction for native PDFs and Word files, and the Qwen3-VL-8B path for designed PDFs.
modules.title: Inside language models

modules.summary: Ch. 4–6: text classification, clustering and topic modeling, and prompt engineering. Project: exact and semantic search, the routing heuristic, and the thin FastAPI layer.
modules.title: Using pretrained models

modules.summary: Ch. 7–9: advanced text generation, semantic search and RAG, and multimodal models. Project: a UI pass in the Swiss/Bauhaus vocabulary. Week 9 is light.
modules.title: Generation, search and vision

modules.summary: Ch. 10–12: embedding models, and fine-tuning for classification and generation. Project: write the engineering rationale, delete one component and rebuild it yourself, then record the demo.
modules.title: Training and fine-tuning

modules.summary: Ch. 1–3: generative models, LangChain's building blocks, and setting up model providers. The first edition predates LangChain 0.1, so expect to port some examples to the current API.
modules.title: Foundations

modules.summary: Ch. 4–5: capable assistants with tools and reasoning strategies, then a ChatGPT-like chatbot with retrieval and memory.
modules.title: Assistants and chatbots

modules.summary: Ch. 6–7: developing software with generative AI, and LLMs for data science.
modules.title: Code and data

modules.summary: Ch. 8–10: conditioning and fine-tuning models, evaluation, deployment and observability, and where generative models are heading. Week 9 is light.
modules.title: Customization and production

modules.summary: Ch. 1–2: what reasoning models are, and generating text with a pretrained LLM.
modules.title: Reasoning basics

modules.summary: Ch. 3: evaluating reasoning models.
modules.title: Evaluation

modules.summary: Ch. 4–5: inference-time scaling, and self-refinement.
modules.title: Inference-time scaling

modules.summary: Ch. 6–7: training reasoning models with reinforcement learning, then improving GRPO. Week 9 is light.
modules.title: Reinforcement learning

modules.summary: Ch. 8: distilling reasoning models for efficient reasoning, then comparing your model with its base.
modules.title: Distillation
